name: qlrisk_price_interest_rate_cap
title: Price a InterestRateCap
description:
Price one Interest Rate Cap - series of caplets (qlrisk InterestRateCap).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, strike_pct*, floating_index=SOFR, frequency=quarterly, volatility_pct, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, day_count, position.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000, "strike_pct": 4} gives NPV 292,656.39 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
